summary: 27-year-old Fort Collins climber Carolyn Davidson stranded off the fixed rappel route while descending the Casual Route on The Diamond, Longs Peak; ~25-person night technical rescue by RMNP rangers with interagency helicopter support; assisted to the summit via upper Kiener's Route and flown off the next morning, uninjured.
location: The Diamond, east face of Longs Peak
responding_agency: RMNP rangers (NPS), Rocky Mountain Rescue Group (standby)
notes: Estes Park News published this report July 22, 2010 (updated March 30, 2015); it describes the July 20, 2010 rescue, not a 2021 incident. Duplicate of 12d4d649-b6c2-4f2a-bdae-baa11cbd1440; retained for provenance and ID compatibility.
